title: Global Tech Recruiter Pleno
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Global Tech Recruiter Pleno em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are looking for a Mid-Level International Recruiter to join the Talent Acquisition team, focusing on global hiring for AI/R Company. Companies such as Avenue Code, Invillia, and Compass UOL are part of the group.

We are seeking a professional with an ownership mindset , resilience, and a strong consultative approach to join the team. You will be responsible for managing high-complexity roles in competitive markets, acting as a strategic partner to our clients and international leadership.


What you will be responsible for:

  • Manage the full recruitment lifecycle (end-to-end) for technical and niche roles across regions such as the U.S., Canada, and Europe
  • Act as a consultant to stakeholders and Customer Success teams, providing market intelligence on rates, talent availability, and local hiring models
  • Develop and execute advanced sourcing strategies to identify top-tier technology talent (Dev, QA, DevOps, Data, etc.)
  • Take ownership of building and maintaining talent pipelines, proactively reporting metrics in a strategic manner
  • Lead communication with international candidates, ensuring an excellent and engaging candidate experience
  • Leverage ATS, LinkedIn Recruiter, and other sourcing tools, ensuring data integrity and quality
  • Identify bottlenecks in processes and propose fast solutions to meet aggressive SLAs
  • Contribute strategically to employer branding and global talent attraction initiatives


What you need to have:

  • Solid experience in international recruitment (mandatory experience hiring local professionals in the U.S., Canada, or Europe)
  • Background in recruiting within consulting companies
  • Proven track record of delivering high-quality candidates under tight SLAs
  • Strong expertise in sourcing strategies (Boolean Strings, X-Ray search) and deep interest in the global tech market
  • High level of self-management, organization, and results orientation
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Fluent English for daily conversation and negotiation with global stakeholders


Nice to have:

  • Knowledge of work visas and geographic specificities of North American and European markets



Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and compliance with the most rigorous data protection regulations worldwide, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA, and CPRA. Candidates’ data will be kept confidential and used exclusively for recruitment purposes and may be shared with clients and companies within the Compass UOL Group involved in projects.

title: Desenvolvedor de Software Sênior - Protheus
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Desenvolvedor de Software Sênior - Protheus em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA:

Buscamos um Analista de Desenvolvimento Sênior III com sólido domínio no ecossistema TOTVS Protheus para atuar em projetos estratégicos de alta complexidade. Este profissional será responsável por desenhar e implementar soluções robustas, garantindo a performance, escalabilidade e integridade do ERP, além de atuar como referência técnica para o time.


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:

  • Desenvolver, sustentar e otimizar rotinas complexas utilizando ADVPL e TLPP.
  • Arquitetar, implementar e sustentar integrações via APIs REST e Web Services para comunicação com sistemas externos, processos automáticos complexos JOBS e SCHEDULES.
  • Garantir a qualidade do código através de práticas de Code Review e aplicação de padrões de projeto (MVC, Orientação a Objetos).
  • Colaborar estrategicamente com as áreas de negócio para traduzir necessidades funcionais (Financeiro, Fiscal, Faturamento, etc.) em soluções técnicas eficientes.
  • Promover a mentoria técnica de desenvolvedores Plenos e Juniores, disseminando boas práticas e novos conhecimentos.
  • Participar ativamente de cerimônias em Metodologias Ágeis (Scrum/Kanban).


O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:

  • Linguagens : Domínio avançado em ADVPL e TLPP (Ênfase em classes e REST).
  • Arquitetura: Experiência sólida em Orientação a Objetos e integrações REST/SOAP.
  • Ambiente escalável de alta demanda (Jobs/Schedules com multi-thread)
  • Banco de Dados: Conhecimento profundo em SQL Server ou Oracle (Queries, Procedures e Tuning).
  • Gestão de Código: Experiência com ferramentas de controle de versão (Git, GitLab ou Azure DevOps).
  • Testes Unitários / TDD: Criar testes de alta complexidade, sejam estes manuais ou automatizados.


Requisitos desejáveis:

  • Ensino superior completo em Administração, Economia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Disponibilidade para atuação 100% presencial em Feira de Santana - BA.
  • Excel avançado incluindo modelagem financeira e construção de modelos de pricing, margem e rentabilidade, uso avançado de funções (ÍNDICE, CORRESP, SOMASES, PROCV/XLOOKUP, SE, MATRIZ, LET, LAMBDA), Tabelas Dinâmicas avançadas, Power Query e Power Pivot para tratamento, consolidação e análise de grandes volumes de dados.
  • Vivência com planejamento financeiro, orçamento e Forecast, com domínio de análise de variações (Real x Orçado / Forecast) e identificação de drivers de resultado.
  • Vivência com custos e formação de preços incluindo conceitos de custo standard, custo médio e margem de contribuição, sistemas de custeio (absorção, real e padrão) e análise de rentabilidade por produto, linha, cliente e canal.
  • Experiência com pricing e rentabilidade, com capacidade de modelar preços considerando custos, impostos, margens-alvo, mix e estratégia comercial, realizar simulações de cenários e análises de impacto econômico-financeiro e suportar negociações comerciais com dados, argumentos e análises estruturadas.
  • Experiência com gestão e controle de verbas comerciais, incluindo análise de retorno sobre investimento (ROI), mensuração de impactos em margem, volume e resultado e acompanhamento da execução orçamentária das ações comerciais.

  • Conhecimento do processo comercial e logístico, entendendo seus reflexos em custos, preços, nível de serviço e capital de giro.
  • Conhecimento com ferramentas de BI e visualização de dados (Power BI, Tableau ou similares), com capacidade de construir dashboards gerenciais e executivos, analisar indicadores como margem, pricing waterfall, ROI de verbas comerciais, forecast accuracy e traduzir dados complexos em insights claros para tomada de decisão.
  • Experiência com manipulação e análise de bases de dados massivas, garantindo consistência, rastreabilidade e governança da informação.
  • Experiência com Sistemas Integrados (ERP), com habilidade para extração, validação e cruzamento de dados financeiros e comerciais e entendimento dos impactos de cadastros, condições comerciais e impostos nos resultados.
  • Desejável Inglês (leitura, escrita e conversação).

Ao nos enviar seu currículo e dados pessoais, considera-se que você deu seu consentimento para que mantenhamos suas informações em nosso banco de dados de recrutamento de talentos. title: Java Software Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Java Software Engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Company Description

Theta Data is a pioneering data company specializing in low-latency APIs for delivering high-speed options and stocks data. Our mission is to empower users with real-time, actionable information to make well-informed decisions in dynamic financial markets. With a focus on speed and broad data coverage, Theta Data stands at the forefront of the options data industry by providing essential tools and insights. We are dedicated to equipping professionals with the resources needed to excel in a competitive landscape.


We’re a small, nimble team growing quickly. Our platform handles billions of database requests daily, and we’re just getting started. The complexity of our data problems is real: tick-level options data is among the most intricate financial data to store, index, and serve at scale. We take engineering seriously.


Role Description

We’re hiring backend-focused Software Engineers to help build and scale the services that power Theta Data. This is a hands-on coding role. You’ll be writing production code from day one. We are looking for self-starting engineers who think deeply about system scale, creatively solve problems, and can move forward in high ambiguity.


You’ll join a lean engineering team where your work has a direct, visible impact on the platform and the customers who use it. We have new services to architect, bottlenecks to eliminate, and workflows to redesign from scratch.


Additionally, you’ll support live systems, investigate and resolve bugs, and help keep a platform that customers depend on running smoothly.


What you will work on

  • Design, build, and scale backend services handling billions of requests daily
  • Architect new systems and contribute to technical direction
  • Improve and automate customer onboarding workflows
  • Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks across the stack
  • Collaborate directly with the team and senior technical leadership


Our Technical Stack

  • Java - core backend services, business logic, API, thick client
  • Python - scripting, tooling
  • Apache Tomcat - servlet container
  • Java Servlets - HTTP request handling
  • PostgreSQL + Hibernate
  • gRPC
  • AI coding tools (Claude, Gemini, Copilot) - we use them, you should too


What we are looking for

We hire for fundamentals, ownership, and a love of building. Depending on your experience level, here’s what we care about:


Required

  • Deep proficiency in Java with a strong command of the language and ecosystem
  • Proven experience optimizing application performance through JVM heap tuning, garbage collection analysis, and memory allocation strategies
  • Strong computer science fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, and systems-level thinking
  • Demonstrated experience designing, building, and maintaining REST APIs and backend services
  • Working knowledge of HTTP, authentication protocols, and modern web architecture


Nice to Have

  • Experience working in data-intensive, low-latency environments where performance matters
  • Hands-on experience with PostgreSQL, including schema design and query optimization
  • Python development experience for tooling, scripting, or service work
  • Familiarity with Apache Tomcat in production or staging environments
  • Frontend exposure with TypeScript and a modern UI library or framework (Vue, React, or similar)
  • Experience designing or maintaining CI/CD pipelines for automated build, test, and deployment


Why Theta Data

  • Rapid growth: the platform and team are both scaling fast
  • Real engineering challenges: data at scale, low-latency systems, complex financial data
  • High ownership: a small team means your decisions matter and ship quickly
  • Greenfield opportunities: new systems to design, not just legacy to maintain
  • Remote-first: work from anywhere
  • Direct impact: your work reaches thousands of quants and researchers daily

About the Company

We are a forward-thinking technology organization dedicated to developing innovative software solutions that improve outcomes for clients and end-users. Our engineering team designs, builds, and maintains scalable, high-quality applications that drive efficiency and innovation across industries. We are seeking an experienced Level III Software Engineer (contractor) to join our distributed team, contributing to complex projects with a focus on code quality, security, and collaboration.


Position Overview

As a Level III Software Engineer (contractor), you will apply your technical expertise to deliver high-quality code for moderately to highly complex projects. Working remotely with a U.S.-based team, you'll gain deep system knowledge and contribute to an Agile development workflow using Azure DevOps.

You will begin with automated testing and peer reviews, expanding into broader development tasks by months 2–3. The role will continue to evolve based on your strengths and project needs, while maintaining rigorous adherence to coding and security standards.


Key Responsibilities

  • Product Design & Development: Collaborate with stakeholders to design and implement software solutions aligned with technical and business objectives.
  • Code Contributions: Write, optimize, and maintain efficient code, including enhancement of existing codebases, beginning around months 3–4.
  • Testing & Quality: Design and implement automated end-to-end (E2E) tests (e.g., using Microsoft Playwright) to ensure feature stability—especially during the first 6–9 months.
  • Peer Reviews: Participate in pre-release feature reviews and early post-release bug analysis (first 90 days), transitioning to broader ownership over time.
  • Agile Workflow Participation: Actively contribute to sprints, pull requests, and releases within a 2-week sprint / 6-week release cycle using Azure DevOps.
  • Collaboration: Communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical team members across multiple time zones.


Qualifications


Experience

  • 5–8 years of software engineering experience with a demonstrated record of success on complex projects.


Technical Skills

  • Proficiency in C# ASP.NET (.NET 8) for web applications and APIs.
  • Experience with .NET MAUI and Blazor Web Applications (.NET 8) , leveraging web expertise for cross-platform or mobile development.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Azure services, including Azure App Service, Azure SQL, and Azure Storage.
  • Strong understanding of modern development tools (e.g., Visual Studio, Git, Azure DevOps).
  • Knowledge of secure coding practices and general cybersecurity principles.
  • Experience with cloud platforms and Agile methodologies .


Soft Skills

  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical abilities.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills for remote collaboration.
  • Ability to work independently and within a collaborative team environment.


Preferred

  • Experience with regulated or data-sensitive software environments (e.g., healthcare, financial services, HIPAA, PHI).
  • Prior experience conducting pull-request reviews and participating in Agile sprints.


What We Offer

  • Opportunity to work on impactful, large-scale technology projects.
  • Collaborative, high-performance engineering culture focused on quality and innovation.
  • Flexible remote work environment with a structured onboarding process for success.


How We Work

  • Agile Workflow: Two-week sprints within a six-week release cycle, including daily stand-ups (3:00 PM CT), sprint planning, and reviews.
  • Code Standards: Strict adherence to best practices, peer reviews, and security testing (e.g., OWASP, Detectify).
  • Tool Stack: Azure DevOps, Visual Studio, SQL Server Management Studio, Datadog, Microsoft Playwright, and related technologies.
  • Team Culture: A focus on accountability, collaboration, and excellence in delivery.

title: Sr. Compliance OnBoarding Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Sr. Compliance OnBoarding Specialist em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Role


We are looking for a highly motivated and detail-oriented Senior Compliance Onboarding Specialist to join our growing team at Velafi. In this role, you will be instrumental in managing and enhancing the onboarding and KYC (Know Your Customer) processes for our clients across multiple jurisdictions, with a strong focus on Brazil and Latin America.


You will collaborate closely with Sales, Operations, and Compliance teams to design efficient, scalable onboarding frameworks that deliver a seamless customer experience while maintaining strict adherence to regulatory requirements. This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced fintech environment and is passionate about balancing compliance excellence with business enablement.


Key Responsibilities


  • Contribute to the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of onboarding controls, policies, and procedures to ensure efficiency, scalability, and regulatory compliance.
  • Act as the subject matter expert for onboarding clients operating in Brazil, ensuring alignment with Brazilian local AML/CTF regulations and industry best practices.
  • Perform detailed reviews and analysis of B2B customer documentation, including Customer Risk Assessments and Customer Due Diligence to support informed onboarding decisions.
  • Partner with Sales, Operations, and other internal stakeholders to provide clear guidance on compliance requirements, enabling smooth client onboarding and expansion into new markets. Advise internal teams on AML risks and regulatory considerations when entering new industries or geographic regions.
  • Conduct background checks, adverse media screenings, and ongoing monitoring of clients and prospects to identify and mitigate potential risks.
  • Support the Compliance function in applying regulatory frameworks across LATAM jurisdictions, ensuring compliant operations in Brazil matters.


What We’re Looking For


  • Bachelor’s degree in Law, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field, with a strong foundation in Compliance.
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in Compliance, preferably within fintech, digital banking, payments, or financial services environments.
  • Strong knowledge of KYC, AML, CDD, and CRA frameworks
  • Solid understanding of Brazilian AML/CTF regulations
  • Familiarity with international regulatory standards, including BSA, USA PATRIOT Act, and OFAC
  • Ability to evaluate complex customer structures, identify risks, and make sound compliance decisions.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to work cross-functionally and communicate complex regulatory concepts clearly.
  • Fluent in Spanish (English is a strong plus).
  • Proactive, detail-oriented, and comfortable operating in a dynamic, fast-growing environment with evolving regulatory landscapes.

title: Database Reliability Engineer - DBRE
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Database Reliability Engineer - DBRE em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Somos a Vortigo - nascemos com o propósito de criar aplicativos mobile para um mundo em constante movimento, mas não paramos por aí. Ampliamos nossa atuação e hoje desenvolvemos softwares para ajudar empresas e startups no processo de transformação digital.

Nosso time é composto por pessoas apaixonadas por desafios gigantes, mudando a experiência dos usuários a nível global.

Estamos espalhados pelo Brasil e pelo mundo, tocando projetos nacionais e internacionais.

Nosso ambiente é descontraído, com uma cultura horizontal, muita troca de conhecimento, reconhecimento e desafios! Tá afim de fazer parte de tudo isso?

Dá uma olhada no que estamos buscando:


Estamos em busca de um(a) DBRE (Database Reliability Engineer) para atuar em um ambiente orientado por Data Mesh , com foco em resiliência, automação e governança de dados distribuídos . Essa pessoa será responsável por garantir a confiabilidade, performance e escalabilidade dos bancos de dados utilizados pelas equipes de produto e engenharia.


Responsabilidades:

  • Projetar e implementar estratégias de confiabilidade para bancos de dados em domínios distribuídos.
  • Automatizar processos de provisionamento, backup, monitoramento e recuperação de bancos de dados.
  • Trabalhar em parceria com os times de produto e engenharia para garantir boas práticas de modelagem e performance.
  • Atuar na observabilidade e rastreabilidade dos dados em ambientes SQL e NoSQL.
  • Participar da definição de padrões e políticas de governança de dados dentro da arquitetura Data Mesh.
  • Realizar troubleshooting e tuning de queries e estruturas de dados.
  • Gerenciar e otimizar recursos de banco de dados em AWS , utilizando serviços como RDS, Aurora, EC2, S3, CloudWatch, IAM e Secrets Manager .


Requisitos Técnicos:

  • Experiência avançada com SQL Server , PostgreSQL e MongoDB .
  • Domínio de AWS , especialmente em serviços voltados para bancos de dados e infraestrutura.
  • Conhecimento em infraestrutura como código (IaC) com Terraform ou CloudFormation .
  • Automação com PowerShell, Bash ou Python .

This position will work directly with US-based customers and distributed engineering teams across the US, Brazil, and Costa Rica.

This is not a traditional backend development role.

You will help design, build, and operate AI-driven engineering workflows that automate software development activities using modern LLMs and agent frameworks. The role combines backend engineering, AI workflow orchestration, prompt engineering, and critical review of AI-generated code.

The ideal candidate is comfortable working across both software engineering and applied AI domains — building automation while also validating and improving generated outputs.

  • Build integrations between LLMs, internal tooling, and engineering platforms
  • Create and refine prompts, templates, structured outputs, and agent behaviors
  • Review, validate, and improve AI-generated .NET code and pull requests

  • Build evaluation and verification mechanisms for AI-generated outputs
  • Collaborate with architects and engineering teams to follow enterprise standards and patterns
  • Debug and optimize agent execution flows, tooling integrations, and orchestration logic
  • Contribute to platform reliability, observability, and operational efficiency


Required Qualifications

  • Strong experience with C# and .NET Core
  • Strong experience with SQL and Entity Framework
  • Strong Azure Cloud experience, including services such as Azure Functions, API Management, Service Bus, Managed Identities, etc.
  • Experience building CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps
  • Ability to read and interpret technical and architectural documentation
  • Hands-on experience working with modern LLM platforms such as OpenAI, Claude, or similar
  • Working proficiency in Python for scripting, automation, or AI workflows
  • Experience with prompt engineering and AI workflow design
  • Familiarity with at least one modern AI/agent framework, such as Semantic Kernel, LangGraph, AutoGen, Claude Agent SDK, and similar frameworks
  • Strong problem-solving and debugging skills
  • Advanced English communication skills


Nice to Have

  • Experience with developer tooling or engineering automation
  • AI-assisted code generation or PR automation experience
  • Familiarity with MCP (Model Context Protocol)

  • Experience with Blazor or legacy .NET Framework applications
  • Exposure to prompt versioning, evaluation pipelines, or LLM testing strategies


What We Are Looking For

We are looking for engineers who:

  • enjoy solving complex technical problems;
  • are comfortable working with emerging AI technologies;
  • can balance engineering quality with experimentation;
  • have a hands-on mindset;
  • can critically evaluate AI-generated outputs rather than blindly trusting them.

title: Java Software Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Java Software Engineer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Company Description

Theta Data is a pioneering data company specializing in low-latency APIs for delivering high-speed options and stocks data. Our mission is to empower users with real-time, actionable information to make well-informed decisions in dynamic financial markets. With a focus on speed and broad data coverage, Theta Data stands at the forefront of the options data industry by providing essential tools and insights. We are dedicated to equipping professionals with the resources needed to excel in a competitive landscape.


We’re a small, nimble team growing quickly. Our platform handles billions of database requests daily, and we’re just getting started. The complexity of our data problems is real: tick-level options data is among the most intricate financial data to store, index, and serve at scale. We take engineering seriously.


Role Description

We’re hiring backend-focused Software Engineers to help build and scale the services that power Theta Data. This is a hands-on coding role. You’ll be writing production code from day one. We are looking for self-starting engineers who think deeply about system scale, creatively solve problems, and can move forward in high ambiguity.


You’ll join a lean engineering team where your work has a direct, visible impact on the platform and the customers who use it. We have new services to architect, bottlenecks to eliminate, and workflows to redesign from scratch.


Additionally, you’ll support live systems, investigate and resolve bugs, and help keep a platform that customers depend on running smoothly.


What you will work on

  • Design, build, and scale backend services handling billions of requests daily
  • Architect new systems and contribute to technical direction
  • Improve and automate customer onboarding workflows
  • Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks across the stack
  • Collaborate directly with the team and senior technical leadership


Our Technical Stack

  • Java - core backend services, business logic, API, thick client
  • Python - scripting, tooling
  • Apache Tomcat - servlet container
  • Java Servlets - HTTP request handling
  • PostgreSQL + Hibernate
  • gRPC
  • AI coding tools (Claude, Gemini, Copilot) - we use them, you should too


What we are looking for

We hire for fundamentals, ownership, and a love of building. Depending on your experience level, here’s what we care about:


Required

  • Deep proficiency in Java with a strong command of the language and ecosystem
  • Proven experience optimizing application performance through JVM heap tuning, garbage collection analysis, and memory allocation strategies
  • Strong computer science fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, and systems-level thinking
  • Demonstrated experience designing, building, and maintaining REST APIs and backend services
  • Working knowledge of HTTP, authentication protocols, and modern web architecture


Nice to Have

  • Experience working in data-intensive, low-latency environments where performance matters
  • Hands-on experience with PostgreSQL, including schema design and query optimization
  • Python development experience for tooling, scripting, or service work
  • Familiarity with Apache Tomcat in production or staging environments
  • Frontend exposure with TypeScript and a modern UI library or framework (Vue, React, or similar)
  • Experience designing or maintaining CI/CD pipelines for automated build, test, and deployment


Why Theta Data

  • Rapid growth: the platform and team are both scaling fast
  • Real engineering challenges: data at scale, low-latency systems, complex financial data
  • High ownership: a small team means your decisions matter and ship quickly
  • Greenfield opportunities: new systems to design, not just legacy to maintain
  • Remote-first: work from anywhere
  • Direct impact: your work reaches thousands of quants and researchers daily

title: SAP Solution Architect (Basis / Hyperscaler)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para SAP Solution Architect (Basis / Hyperscaler) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Na NTT DATA Business Solutions, impulsionamos a inovação – desde consultoria e implementação até serviços gerenciados e além, impulsionados por uma equipe global e mais de 18.500 especialistas representando mais de 90 nações em mais de 30 países. Com a SAP no nosso núcleo e um poderoso ecossistema de parceiros como Microsoft e ServiceNow, continuamos aprimorando soluções e tecnologias baseadas em IA para que funcionem para as empresas e para suas pessoas.


Conosco, você tem infinitas oportunidades para pensar grande, agir com ousadia e assumir a responsabilidade. Faça deste o lugar onde você pertence, aprende e constrói sua rede.


Make this the place where you grow!


Buscamos um(a) SAP Solution Architect com sólida experiência técnica em SAP Basis, certificação SAP PCA e atuação como especialista em arquiteturas SAP em ambientes hyperscaler certificados, para apoiar projetos estratégicos de System Move, Migration e Upgrades, além de iniciativas de pré‑vendas. Esse profissional será responsável por definir, validar e governar arquiteturas técnicas SAP em ambientes on‑premise, cloud e híbridos, assegurando viabilidade técnica, segurança, performance, escalabilidade e total aderência às melhores práticas e recomendações oficiais da SAP.


Principais Responsabilidades:



  • Definir e desenhar arquiteturas técnicas SAP para projetos de:
  • System Move (on‑premise ↔ cloud / datacenter); System Migration (ECC para S/4HANA, conversões técnicas e transformações de landscape); Upgrades SAP (tecnológicos e funcionais).
  • Atuar como especialista em arquiteturas SAP em hyperscalers certificados SAP, garantindo conformidade com padrões de:
  • Disponibilidade; Segurança; Performance; Escalabilidade.
  • Exercer o papel de arquiteto técnico e referência SAP Basis em projetos SAP de média e alta complexidade.
  • Apoiar processos de pré‑vendas, incluindo:
  • Análise de requisitos técnicos; Definição da arquitetura de solução;
  • Avaliação de riscos, premissas e dependências técnicas; Estimativas de esforço e definição da abordagem técnica;
  • Participação em reuniões com clientes e apresentações executivas.
  • Avaliar impactos técnicos relacionados a:
  • Migração e saneamento de dados;
  • Integrações SAP e sistemas legados;
  • Performance, alta disponibilidade, segurança e continuidade operacional.
  • Garantir aderência às boas práticas SAP, recomendações oficiais e padrões corporativos de arquitetura.
  • Apoiar equipes funcionais e técnicas na tomada de decisões arquiteturais ao longo de todo o ciclo de vida dos projetos.


Requisitos:


  • Certificação SAP PCA (perfil SAP Basis).
  • Experiência comprovada em projetos de Move, Migration e Upgrades SAP.
  • Atuação como especialista em arquiteturas SAP em hyperscalers certificados SAP.
  • Conhecimento sólido em: SAP S/4HANA; Arquitetura SAP on‑premise, cloud e híbrida; Ambientes hyperscaler certificados SAP; Integrações SAP; Landscapes SAP, governança técnica e migração de dados.
  • Forte capacidade de análise, identificação e mitigação de riscos técnicos.


Diferenciais:


  • Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita, com habilidade para interação com públicos técnicos e executivos.
  • Perfil consultivo, com visão end‑to‑end e forte orientação à solução.
  • Experiência prévia em pré‑vendas SAP.
  • Vivência em projetos SAP de grande porte e ambientes críticos.
  • Experiência em apresentações executivas e condução de workshops técnicos.



Regime de Contratação: Modelo de CLT

AWS native Architecture

Systems Integration

Work with internal teams to understand operational processes and translate them into scalable technical solutions.


AI Forward Development

Identify opportunities to expand AI‑driven automation across the platform.


Collaboration & Impact

What We Are Looking For

  • Comfortable working across the stack (backend‑heavy, but able to contribute to frontend).

Why Freight Hero

description:

⚠️ IMPORTANT: In order to apply, complete the test in After Effects (99% won't do it)! Copy and paste this link into your browser to get started:



If you just use LinkedIn's \"Easy Apply\" you will not be considered for this role.


Overview:

We are 100C ( an 8-person YouTube agency based in the United States that creates and grows YouTube channels for business owners. We need a new ADVANCED YouTube editor experienced in After Effects to take over for one of our well-established clients.


About the role:

We do all of our video editing (except for color grading and sound) in After Effects, so we’re looking for a video editor who is skilled with the software. Your role will be handling all the video editing for one of our well-established clients. Your job will include everything necessary to make professional YouTube videos, such as:

  • Color grading
  • Trimming
  • Audio post production
  • Planning the appropriate visuals for each video
  • Finding footage and imagery that match our clients’ branding
  • Using AI effectively to generate custom visuals
  • Laying out media
  • Importing and using motion graphic templates
  • Creating custom animations
  • Creating AI avatars (we'll show you how)
  • Finding and editing appropriate music
  • Finding and editing appropriate sound effects
  • Strategic editing (understanding what to cut, what to include, and how to structure it for maximum engagement)


Here is a reel of our work to give you an idea of the type of video editing we do:


Our Values:

It's important that you are in alignment with our values. If this doesn't sound like you, do NOT apply:


  • Quality First - We are a PREMIUM agency, so it's important that you're driven to constantly do your best work and take your skills to the next level. If you're just looking for a job that is easy to do and doesn't require you to think carefully about your editing, this role is NOT for you.


  • High Accountability - You want to take responsibility for your successes AND your failures. If we call you out for doing poor-quality work or delivering late, you have the emotional maturity to take ownership for it and use that to drive you to do better next time.


  • Directness - We don't beat around the bush. If you do great work, we praise you and let you know. Similarly, if something is bad, we tell you it's bad. If you can't take direct criticism, this role is NOT for you.


  • Independence - You are good at solving your own problems. We are here to help, and will go out of our way to train you and make you feel comfortable in your role, but you should be eager to own this position and do it well without us needing to constantly push you.


Additional Requirements:

Below is a list of additional requirements for the job, please read through it carefully before applying:

  • Advanced English proficiency
  • Available the equivalent of full-time (at least 40 hours per week)
  • Willing to work on weekends when necessary
  • Available to start within the next two weeks
  • Advanced After Effects skills: 3D, Rotoscoping, Masking, Motion tracking, Keying, Expressions
  • Have a “design eye”: the ability to create and follow aesthetic branding guidelines
  • Professional, meaning you deliver professional-grade work on time
  • Highly responsive


The Offer:

If hired, we will provide free copies of all the plugins we use ($500 in tools), pay for your Magnific (formerly Freepik) and Envato accounts, and teach you how to edit videos in After Effects the same way we do.


Your starting pay will be $1,500-$2,500USD per month depending on your skill level. Once you show us that you can complete the work without needing much feedback, we will increase your monthly base by $500USD. You can also earn a performance bonus of $500USD every month. So you have potential to be making as much as $3,500USD/mo within months of starting (if you're good).

title: Liquidity Partnership Manager (LATAM)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Liquidity Partnership Manager (LATAM) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Role Overview

We are looking for an LP Partnership Manager to drive business development and build strong relationships with liquidity providers across key regions. This role will be instrumental in sourcing, onboarding, and managing LP partners, while working closely with the trading team to optimize liquidity, pricing, and execution.

The ideal candidate is highly connected within the local market, with a strong network of liquidity providers and a deep understanding of regional payment and banking landscapes.


Key Responsibilities

Business Development & Partnerships

  • Identify, source, and establish relationships with local and regional liquidity providers
  • Evaluate LP quality (pricing, depth, reliability, regions covered)
  • Negotiate trading terms (spreads, fees, credit lines, margin terms)


Market & Network Development

  • Leverage existing network to expand LP coverage in key regions (APAC, LATAM, Africa)
  • Maintain strong relationships with banks, payment providers, and liquidity partners
  • Stay up to date with local market dynamics, pricing trends, and competitive landscape


Execution & Collaboration

  • Work closely with traders to ensure optimal liquidity, pricing, and execution quality
  • Coordinate with internal teams to onboard LPs and ensure smooth operational setup
  • Support ongoing performance monitoring and optimization of LP relationships


Banking & Infrastructure Setup

  • Facilitate opening of bank accounts and payment rails required for LP operations
  • Identify suitable partners to support local currency flows and settlement


Requirements

  • 5 to 10 years of experience in business development, partnerships, or liquidity management
  • Strong experience in payments, FX, trading, or related financial services
  • Well connected with liquidity providers, banks, and payment partners
  • Proven ability to source and onboard LPs in local markets
  • Strong understanding of regional market structures and liquidity dynamics
  • Must have strong, deep LP network in at least one of the following regions: LATAM


Vision & Mission

  • OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
  • OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Product Design Lead em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

No Grupo SBF, reunimos duas grandes forças do esporte no Brasil: a Centauro, maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina, e a Fisia, distribuidora oficial da Nike no país.


Queremos ser referência em esporte no Brasil e construir um futuro em que cada experiência com o esporte inspire, motive e transforme.


E aí, que tal vestir essa camisa com a gente?


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Garantir qualidade e consistência das entregas de design dentro da tribo;
  • Co-garantir, junto a PMs e Engenharia, que as entregas gerem valor para o cliente e impacto nos indicadores de negócio;
  • Identificar e priorizar oportunidades de experiência e produto em conjunto com GPM e PM;
  • Liderar a operação de design na tribo, reduzindo fricções e desalinhamentos entre squads;

  • Contribuir para definição de critérios de qualidade e “Ready for Dev”;
  • Garantir previsibilidade e sustentabilidade operacional da atuação de design.

  • Experiência consolidada em Product Design, atuando em produtos digitais (web e mobile);
  • Experiência em contextos ágeis e multidisciplinares (produto, tecnologia, dados);
  • Experiência liderando designers formal ou informalmente.


Desejável


  • Experiência prévia em empresas de varejo digital;
  • Vivência em contextos de escala (múltiplos produtos, alto volume de usuários, complexidade operacional).

title: Senior Technical Consultant – Front Arena
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Technical Consultant – Front Arena em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Why Zensar?

We’re a bunch of hardworking, fun-loving, people-oriented technology enthusiasts. We love what we do, and we’re passionate about helping our clients thrive in an increasingly complex digital world. Zensar is an organization focused on building relationships with our clients and with each other—and happiness is at the core of everything we do. In fact, we’re so into happiness that we’ve created a Global Happiness Council, and we send out a Happiness Survey to our employees each year. We’ve learned that employee happiness requires more than a competitive paycheck, and our employee value proposition—grow, own, achieve, learn (GOAL)—lays out the core opportunities we seek to foster for every employee. Teamwork and collaboration are critical to Zensar’s mission and success, and our teams work on a diverse and challenging mix of technologies across a broad industry spectrum. These industries include banking and financial services, high-tech and manufacturing, healthcare, insurance, retail, and consumer services. Our employees enjoy flexible work arrangements and a competitive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, 401(k), among other benefits. If you are looking for a place to have an immediate impact, to grow and contribute, where we work hard, play hard, and support each other, consider joining team Zensar!


Zensar is looking for a Senior Technical Consultant – Front Arena .


About the Role

The Senior Technical Consultant will act as the technical SME for the Front Arena implementation, responsible for overall technical design, integrations, and enabling delivery teams during both scoping and execution phases.


Key Responsibilities

Lead technical design for the Front Arena or Murex (MX.3B) or Calypso (Nasdaq) technical configuration (static data, environments) implementation

Own technical architecture, integrations, and system configuration approach

Support scoping activities, including defining technical complexity and risks

Act as technical SME to guide and upskill junior and partner consultants

Work closely with functional leads to ensure coherent front to back solutions

Support on site workshops as required


Required Skills & Experience

Spanish nice to have

Strong Front Arena technical expertise (configuration, architecture, integrations) or Murex (MX.3B) or Calypso (Nasdaq) technical configuration (static data, environments)

Experience with full front to back Front Arena implementations

Prior involvement in large scale / greenfield implementations

Ability to mentor and guide junior technical resources

Experience working in multi vendor delivery models

Spanish language skills strongly preferred

Experience in Latin American / Mexican market environments is a strong advantage,

Competent with Python


Zensar believes that diversity of backgrounds, thought, experience, and expertise fosters the robust exchange of ideas that enables the highest quality collaboration and work product. Zensar is an equal opportunity employer. All employment decisions shall be made without regard to age, race, creed, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, citizenship status or any other basis as protected by federal, state, or local law. Zensar is committed to providing veteran employment opportunities to our service men and women. Zensar is committed to providing equal employment opportunities for people with disabilities or religious observances, including reasonable accommodation when needed. Accommodation made to facilitate the recruiting process are not a guarantee of future or continued accommodation once hired.


All applicants must be legally authorized to work with Zensar. Visa sponsorship may be available for qualified applicants for certain positions.

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Liquidity Partnership Manager (LATAM) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Role Overview

We are looking for an LP Partnership Manager to drive business development and build strong relationships with liquidity providers across key regions. This role will be instrumental in sourcing, onboarding, and managing LP partners, while working closely with the trading team to optimize liquidity, pricing, and execution.

The ideal candidate is highly connected within the local market, with a strong network of liquidity providers and a deep understanding of regional payment and banking landscapes.


Key Responsibilities

Business Development & Partnerships

  • Identify, source, and establish relationships with local and regional liquidity providers
  • Evaluate LP quality (pricing, depth, reliability, regions covered)
  • Negotiate trading terms (spreads, fees, credit lines, margin terms)


Market & Network Development

  • Leverage existing network to expand LP coverage in key regions (APAC, LATAM, Africa)
  • Maintain strong relationships with banks, payment providers, and liquidity partners
  • Stay up to date with local market dynamics, pricing trends, and competitive landscape


Execution & Collaboration

  • Work closely with traders to ensure optimal liquidity, pricing, and execution quality

  • Support ongoing performance monitoring and optimization of LP relationships


Banking & Infrastructure Setup

  • Facilitate opening of bank accounts and payment rails required for LP operations
  • Identify suitable partners to support local currency flows and settlement


Requirements

  • 5 to 10 years of experience in business development, partnerships, or liquidity management

  • Well connected with liquidity providers, banks, and payment partners
  • Proven ability to source and onboard LPs in local markets
  • Strong understanding of regional market structures and liquidity dynamics
  • Must have strong, deep LP network in at least one of the following regions: LATAM


Vision & Mission

  • OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
  • OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Senior Oil & Gas Regulatory & Severance Tax Accountant
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Oil & Gas Regulatory & Severance Tax Accountant em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Location: Brazil (100% Remote)

Experience Level: Mid to Senior (5+ years)

Industry: Oil & Gas (Unconventional Onshore)


Role Summary

We are seeking a highly analytical Senior Regulatory & Severance Tax Accountant to join our integrated Revenue team. The primary focus of this role is to ensure the integrity of severance tax reporting for Texas and Louisiana operations. You will be responsible for identifying, troubleshooting, and resolving reporting discrepancies that lead to state-issued penalties. This is a technical, hands-on role requiring deep experience in SAP PRA (CA/VL modules) and the ability to bridge the gap between transactional data and state regulatory compliance.


Responsibilities

  • Severance Tax Compliance : Lead the end-to-end severance tax reporting process for Texas and Louisiana, ensuring all volumes and values are reported accurately and timely to the respective state agencies.
  • Error Detection & Troubleshooting : Proactively identify reporting errors by comparing state-level data against internal production and valuation records. Utilize the Valuation Control Report (VCR) and specific SAP T-Codes to diagnose root causes of variances.
  • PPA Analysis : Analyze Prior Period Adjustments (PPAs) before posting to understand the ripple effect on the General Ledger (GL), production volumes, and pricing. Ensure all adjustments are justified and accurately reflected in amended filings.
  • Penalty Reduction : Serve as the lead in reducing state-issued penalties through meticulous data validation and the timely filing of amended returns (e.g., Texas G-10/P-5, Louisiana O3).
  • Process Improvement : Troubleshoot systemic process failures and, as needed, document standardized workflows to serve as guides for broader transactional teams.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration : Work as one team with the Revenue Accounting group to ensure that valuation formulas and owner payment setups are consistent with regulatory requirements.



Requirements

  • Minimum of 2 years of hands-on experience in the Check Input (CA) and Valuation (VL) modules. Must have experience booking company-operated revenues and navigating sub-ledger details.
  • At least 5+ years of experience, including experience in Upstream Oil & Gas accounting, ideally focused on unconventional, onshore assets.
  • Proven experience with US (ideally Texas and Louisiana )severance tax regulations, including high-cost gas exemptions and state disposition reporting.
  • Ability to perform deep-dive reconciliations across production, revenue, and tax data sets to identify complex transactional errors.
  • Advanced/Fluent English (written and spoken) is required for coordination with US-based stakeholders.
  • A diagnostic mindset - able to look at a reporting error and trace the logic back through the SAP PRA system to the source data.
  • Capable of managing complex reporting deadlines and independent research in a fully remote environment.


Technical Requirements

  • ERP: SAP PRA (CA, VL modules), S/4HANA (preferred).
  • Reporting Tools: Advanced Excel (Power Query/Pivot), Power BI, VCR Analysis.

About the role:

We do all of our video editing (except for color grading and sound) in After Effects, so we’re looking for a video editor who is skilled with the software.   • Finding and editing appropriate sound effects
  • Strategic editing (understanding what to cut, what to include, and how to structure it for maximum engagement)


Here is a reel of our work to give you an idea of the type of video editing we do:


Our Values:

It's important that you are in alignment with our values. If this doesn't sound like you, do NOT apply:


  • Quality First - We are a PREMIUM agency, so it's important that you're driven to constantly do your best work and take your skills to the next level. If you're just looking for a job that is easy to do and doesn't require you to think carefully about your editing, this role is NOT for you.

Below is a list of additional requirements for the job, please read through it carefully before applying:

  • Advanced English proficiency
  • Available the equivalent of full-time (at least 40 hours per week)
  • Willing to work on weekends when necessary
  • Available to start within the next two weeks
  • Advanced After Effects skills: 3D, Rotoscoping, Masking, Motion tracking, Keying, Expressions
  • Have a “design eye”: the ability to create and follow aesthetic branding guidelines
  • Professional, meaning you deliver professional-grade work on time
  • Highly responsive


The Offer:

If hired, we will provide free copies of all the plugins we use ($500 in tools), pay for your Magnific (formerly Freepik) and Envato accounts, and teach you how to edit videos in After Effects the same way we do.


Your starting pay will be $1,500-$2,500USD per month depending on your skill level. Once you show us that you can complete the work without needing much feedback, we will increase your monthly base by $500USD. You can also earn a performance bonus of $500USD every month. So you have potential to be making as much as $3,500USD/mo within months of starting (if you're good).

title: Senior Python Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Python Engineer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Company:


Windsor.ai has been founded in 2017 in Zürich, , we are growing fast. We connect data from 300+ sources (Facebook Ads, Google Ads, HubSpot, Salesforce, TikTok) to 30+ destinations (Looker Studio, Google Sheets, BigQuery, Snowflake, and LLMs like ChatGPT and Claude). Our customers include Puma, Audi, UBS, Asics and many more.


We are building a platform that makes it easy to connect any data source to any destination. There is more data being generated in the world every day, but the big problem is that the number of tools is also increasing so data must be updated in multiple systems and tools. We are solving this problem.


Role: We are looking for a Senior Python Engineer to join our team, focusing on Python services, API integrations, scalability, and production reliability.


Our Team:


Our team has around 30 people working remotely across Europe. We’re a highly technical team, and even our sales and marketing colleagues are comfortable writing at least some SQL. Our software engineers are specialised in backend with Python and frontend with React


Product:


We have built a data platform connecting to more than 300 different API’s. Big part of our work is dealing with all the complexity and variations in all the different API’s and scalability.


Technology:


We are mostly programming in python and using quite advanced features of python. Most common tools we use:


  • Python : flask, threads, pytest-xdist, pylint
  • Redis, postgres
  • Linux, docker
  • React, redux for frontend


Role Requirements:


  • 4+ years of programming experience.
  • Strong expertise in Python, with experience building and maintaining complex, production-grade systems
  • Good programming knowledge (OOP, mutable/immutable types etc.)
  • Solid experience working in Linux-based development and production environments
  • Enjoy working in a fast-moving organization where you can have a real impact
  • Fluency in English is mandatory


How we work:


We usually plan our work in two weeks intervals but the plan is not super strict so there might be some priorities changed during the sprint. We use Taiga, Gitlab, CI/CD lots of pytest and merge request reviews.


Location: Remote


Windsor.ai is a global team of data engineers and analysts who strive to make data integration effortless and insights easy to extract to everyone. We help businesses of all sizes connect their marketing and sales data, automate reporting, and measure what drives the greatest impact.

• Accept a background check

• 4+ years of work experience with Python (Programming Language)

Why Zensar?

We’re a bunch of hardworking, fun-loving, people-oriented technology enthusiasts. We love what we do, and we’re passionate about helping our clients thrive in an increasingly complex digital world. title: Assistente de Suporte Técnico de TI
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Assistente de Suporte Técnico de TI em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Descrição da Vaga

Atuar na linha de frente do suporte, sendo o ponto focal para nossos usuários internos. O objetivo é garantir a continuidade dos negócios, assegurando que o ambiente de trabalho (físico e lógico) esteja sempre disponível e produtivo. Você será o guardião da experiência do usuário, tratando cada chamado com o senso de urgência e a qualidade que nossos clientes internos exigem.

Principais Responsabilidades

1. Operação e Atendimento (Sustentação)

  • Gestão de Chamados: Atuar no atendimento via sistemas de gestão (GLPI, Jira), respeitando rigorosamente os níveis de serviço (SLAs) e prazos de resolução.
  • Multicanalidade: Prestar suporte técnico ágil e eficiente através de diferentes vias: presencial, telefone, vídeo conferência e chats.
  • Manutenção de Hardware: Executar instalação, desinstalação, configuração e formatação de estações de trabalho (desktops/notebooks).
  • Manutenção Preventiva: Realizar a limpeza física e verificação de periféricos, incluindo impressoras e acessórios, garantindo a longevidade dos equipamentos e evitando falhas.

2. Infraestrutura e Software

  • Software: Instalação, atualização e suporte a softwares, com foco em Pacote Office 365 e sistemas legados/ERP (TOTVS).
  • Redes: Diagnóstico e suporte básico de conectividade (rede local, Wi-Fi e VPN).
  • Gestão de Inventário: Organizar e controlar o estoque de ativos (TI), garantindo a integridade dos equipamentos e auxiliando na gestão eficiente de recursos.

Requisitos Técnicos

  • Formação: Ensino Técnico em TI completo ou cursando/graduado em áreas correlatas (Sistemas de Informação, Redes, Ciência da Computação).
  • Domínio Técnico:
  • Experiência com ferramentas de chamados (GLPI, Jira).
  • Conhecimento prático em ERP (TOTVS) e ecossistema Microsoft (Windows/Office 365).
  • Vivência em montagem, configuração e manutenção física/lógica de computadores.
  • Noções básicas de redes (TCP/IP, impressoras, DNS).

Perfil Comportamental

  • Senso de Urgência & Organização: Entender que o tempo do usuário parado é um custo para a empresa; capacidade de priorizar demandas críticas.
  • Olhar de Dono: Zelo pelo patrimônio, cuidado com o estoque e proatividade para sugerir melhorias contínuas.
  • Comunicação Assertiva: Excelente escrita e fluência verbal para atendimento ao cliente.
  • Empatia: Capacidade de ouvir, compreender a frustração do usuário e prestar um atendimento humano e prestativo.

title: Customer Success Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Customer Success Specialist em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

JoVE is the world- leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role


As a Customer Success Specialist, you will help professors at leading universities in the US integrate JoVE videos into their courses to improve teaching outcomes and student success. You'll play a key role in ensuring users get the most value from their JoVE subscription.



Please share your resume in English.



Responsibilities:


  • Conduct daily outreach to Faculty (via calls, emails, and 1:1 demos) to set up JoVE integrations in courses and increase product usage.
  • Increase JoVE adoption by delivering product awareness sessions across existing customer universities and research institutes.
  • Grow engagement and usage by delivering presentations at (1) exhibits and conferences, (2) university seminars and workshops, and (3) onsite customer visits.
  • Strengthen subscription renewal outcomes by ensuring smooth implementation support, and consistent usage of JoVE resources.
  • Influence product decisions by communicating customer feedback to sales, product, and marketing teams.


Requirements:


  • A master's degree or PhD in Life Science disciplines.
  • Experience in science communications, academic outreach or other customer-facing roles is preferred.
  • Fluent communication skills English.
  • Knowledge of education, market trends, and challenges in assigned content areas i.e. Biology, Chemistry, Medicine, Physics, Engineering, or Psychology.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with a passion for remote relationship-building.
  • Experience in networking using cold calling is preferred.


Why Join JoVE?


  • You can expect compensation packages competitively placed within the local market.
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and in improving student learning in science education.
  • Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us.

title: Senior Oil & Gas Regulatory & Severance Tax Accountant
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Oil & Gas Regulatory & Severance Tax Accountant em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Location: Brazil (100% Remote)

Experience Level: Mid to Senior (5+ years)

Industry: Oil & Gas (Unconventional Onshore)


Role Summary

We are seeking a highly analytical Senior Regulatory & Severance Tax Accountant to join our integrated Revenue team. The primary focus of this role is to ensure the integrity of severance tax reporting for Texas and Louisiana operations. You will be responsible for identifying, troubleshooting, and resolving reporting discrepancies that lead to state-issued penalties. This is a technical, hands-on role requiring deep experience in SAP PRA (CA/VL modules) and the ability to bridge the gap between transactional data and state regulatory compliance.


Responsibilities

  • Severance Tax Compliance : Lead the end-to-end severance tax reporting process for Texas and Louisiana, ensuring all volumes and values are reported accurately and timely to the respective state agencies.
  • Error Detection & Troubleshooting : Proactively identify reporting errors by comparing state-level data against internal production and valuation records. Utilize the Valuation Control Report (VCR) and specific SAP T-Codes to diagnose root causes of variances.
  • PPA Analysis : Analyze Prior Period Adjustments (PPAs) before posting to understand the ripple effect on the General Ledger (GL), production volumes, and pricing. Ensure all adjustments are justified and accurately reflected in amended filings.
  • Penalty Reduction : Serve as the lead in reducing state-issued penalties through meticulous data validation and the timely filing of amended returns (e.g., Texas G-10/P-5, Louisiana O3).
  • Process Improvement : Troubleshoot systemic process failures and, as needed, document standardized workflows to serve as guides for broader transactional teams.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration : Work as one team with the Revenue Accounting group to ensure that valuation formulas and owner payment setups are consistent with regulatory requirements.



Requirements

  • Minimum of 2 years of hands-on experience in the Check Input (CA) and Valuation (VL) modules. Must have experience booking company-operated revenues and navigating sub-ledger details.
  • At least 5+ years of experience, including experience in Upstream Oil & Gas accounting, ideally focused on unconventional, onshore assets.
  • Proven experience with US (ideally Texas and Louisiana )severance tax regulations, including high-cost gas exemptions and state disposition reporting.
  • Ability to perform deep-dive reconciliations across production, revenue, and tax data sets to identify complex transactional errors.
  • Advanced/Fluent English (written and spoken) is required for coordination with US-based stakeholders.
  • A diagnostic mindset - able to look at a reporting error and trace the logic back through the SAP PRA system to the source data.
  • Capable of managing complex reporting deadlines and independent research in a fully remote environment.


Technical Requirements

  • ERP: SAP PRA (CA, VL modules), S/4HANA (preferred).
  • Reporting Tools: Advanced Excel (Power Query/Pivot), Power BI, VCR Analysis.

title: Advanced After Effects YouTube Video Editor
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Advanced After Effects YouTube Video Editor em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

⚠️ IMPORTANT: In order to apply, complete the test in After Effects (99% won't do it)! Copy and paste this link into your browser to get started:



If you just use LinkedIn's \"Easy Apply\" you will not be considered for this role.


Overview:

We are 100C ( an 8-person YouTube agency based in the United States that creates and grows YouTube channels for business owners. We need a new ADVANCED YouTube editor experienced in After Effects to take over for one of our well-established clients.


About the role:

We do all of our video editing (except for color grading and sound) in After Effects, so we’re looking for a video editor who is skilled with the software. Your role will be handling all the video editing for one of our well-established clients. Your job will include everything necessary to make professional YouTube videos, such as:

  • Color grading
  • Trimming
  • Audio post production
  • Planning the appropriate visuals for each video
  • Finding footage and imagery that match our clients’ branding
  • Using AI effectively to generate custom visuals
  • Laying out media
  • Importing and using motion graphic templates
  • Creating custom animations
  • Creating AI avatars (we'll show you how)
  • Finding and editing appropriate music
  • Finding and editing appropriate sound effects
  • Strategic editing (understanding what to cut, what to include, and how to structure it for maximum engagement)


Here is a reel of our work to give you an idea of the type of video editing we do:


Our Values:

It's important that you are in alignment with our values. If this doesn't sound like you, do NOT apply:


  • Quality First - We are a PREMIUM agency, so it's important that you're driven to constantly do your best work and take your skills to the next level. If you're just looking for a job that is easy to do and doesn't require you to think carefully about your editing, this role is NOT for you.


  • High Accountability - You want to take responsibility for your successes AND your failures. If we call you out for doing poor-quality work or delivering late, you have the emotional maturity to take ownership for it and use that to drive you to do better next time.


  • Directness - We don't beat around the bush. If you do great work, we praise you and let you know. Similarly, if something is bad, we tell you it's bad. If you can't take direct criticism, this role is NOT for you.


  • Independence - You are good at solving your own problems. We are here to help, and will go out of our way to train you and make you feel comfortable in your role, but you should be eager to own this position and do it well without us needing to constantly push you.


Additional Requirements:

Below is a list of additional requirements for the job, please read through it carefully before applying:

  • Advanced English proficiency
  • Available the equivalent of full-time (at least 40 hours per week)
  • Willing to work on weekends when necessary
  • Available to start within the next two weeks
  • Advanced After Effects skills: 3D, Rotoscoping, Masking, Motion tracking, Keying, Expressions
  • Have a “design eye”: the ability to create and follow aesthetic branding guidelines
  • Professional, meaning you deliver professional-grade work on time
  • Highly responsive


The Offer:

If hired, we will provide free copies of all the plugins we use ($500 in tools), pay for your Magnific (formerly Freepik) and Envato accounts, and teach you how to edit videos in After Effects the same way we do.


Your starting pay will be $1,500-$2,500USD per month depending on your skill level. Once you show us that you can complete the work without needing much feedback, we will increase your monthly base by $500USD. You can also earn a performance bonus of $500USD every month. So you have potential to be making as much as $3,500USD/mo within months of starting (if you're good).

title: Pessoa Arquiteta de Software .NET
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Pessoa Arquiteta de Software .NET em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Sobre a vaga

A Dimensa está no topo do jogo quando o assunto é tecnologia e infraestrutura para operações financeiras, crédito e risco, e seguros. Nossos sistemas são super escaláveis e adaptáveis, perfeitos para negócios de todos os tamanhos. Nossa equipe de experts vive e respira o setor financeiro, atualizando nossas soluções constantemente para tornar suas operações mais digitais, melhorar a performance, inovar no atendimento aos clientes e garantir que todas as exigências regulatórias sejam 100% cumpridas.


Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência.


Missão:

Garantir a evolução contínua da arquitetura de TI da Dimensa, atuando de forma transversal nas BUs para padronizar tecnologias, impulsionar inovação e assegurar que os produtos atendam a requisitos de escalabilidade, elasticidade, segurança, performance e time-to-market. O arquiteto será responsável por criar frameworks, acelerar a produtividade, viabilizar novos produtos voltados a Dados e IA, apoiar os times de desenvolvimento e infraestrutura, promover a evolução tecnológica, apoiar a operação de sistemas críticos e representar a arquitetura nas frentes corporativas e junto aos clientes, alinhados à estratégia da arquitetura corporativa.


O Que Você Vai fazer (As Principais Entregas):

  • Apoiar as BUs com diretrizes arquiteturais, garantindo aderência e alinhamento estratégico
  • Atuar na construção e manutenção da nova plataforma de aceleração de sistemas
  • Pesquisar e avaliar novas tecnologias visando à evolução tecnológica dos produtos da empresa.
  • Elaborar e gerir documentos técnicos de decisão, como ADRs, RFCs e RFPs, para formalização de propostas e mudanças arquiteturais
  • Realizar governança técnica com foco em riscos, impactos e sustentabilidade das soluções
  • Propor melhorias e novos produtos com base em oportunidades tecnológicas, dados e IA
  • Representar a Arquitetura em fóruns corporativos e alinhar iniciativas estratégicas com as Business Units (BUs)
  • Definir processos relacionados à arquitetura corporativa e governança técnica
  • Atuar diretamente em crises de produtos, identificando gargalos e propondo soluções relacionadas à performance, escalabilidade ou estabilidade
  • Conduzir due diligence técnica de novas soluções, tecnologias, fornecedores e M&A
  • Conduzir estudos e provas de conceito em soluções de IA, com foco em viabilidade e valor
  • Acompanhar tendências tecnológicas e seu impacto nos produtos e na estratégia da empresa


O Que Esperamos de Você (Seu DNA de Arquiteto):

  • Arquitetura de Software moderna (microservices, event-driven, hexagonal, Domain-Driven Design, Dados e IA).
  • Ter capacidade de aprender qualquer tecnologia de Frameworks e linguagens diversas. Ex: .NET, Java, Node.js, Python, PHP, etc
  • Ter capacidade de aprender Cloud & DevOps. Ex: AWS, Azure ou GCP; Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD (GitLab/GitHub Actions).
  • Ter capacidade de aprender qualquer tipo de banco de dados. Ex: SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Oracle, além de NoSQL (MongoDB, Redis), etc.
  • Ter capacidade de aprender Observabilidade & Resiliência: Prometheus/Grafana, Elastic Stack, OpenTelemetry, Circuit Breakers.
  • Ter capacidade de avaliar Segurança. Ex: OWASP Top 10, OAuth2/OIDC, mTLS, gestão de secrets, compliance (LGPD/PCI-DSS).
  • Ter capacidade de utilizar as Metodologias: SCRUM/Kanban, Lean, ITIL, SRE, FinOps básico.
  • Ferramentas de documentação: ADR tools, C4 Model, ArchiMate, Confluence, draw.io.


O Que Oferecemos:

️ Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (flexível)

Assistência Médica

  • Support organizational growth by developing future leaders and strengthening management capabilities
  • Drive alignment and communication across distributed engineering teams operating in multiple time zones
  • Help create a high-performing, inclusive, and transparent remote-first environment

  • 8+ years of software engineering experience with significant engineering leadership responsibility
  • Proven experience managing managers and overseeing multiple engineering teams in a scaling organization
  • Strong background in Agile delivery, DevOps practices, CI/CD, and modern software engineering operations
  • Experience scaling distributed engineering organizations in remote or hybrid environments
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Ability to balance technical quality, delivery execution, and organizational health
  • Strong technical foundation with the ability to guide architectural and engineering decisions
  • Experience partnering closely with Product and executive leadership


Compensation & Benefits:

  • Base salary: $175,000 USD
  • Fully remote - company HQ'd in the US
  • Opportunity to help shape engineering strategy during a high-growth phase

Talent Acquisition Lead LATAM


About the role

AI/R Company is a global ecosystem of technology and innovation that brings together companies specialized in digital transformation, software engineering, data, cloud, and artificial intelligence. The group includes well-known companies in the market such as Avenue Code and Compass UOL, working on strategic projects for major organizations worldwide.


With a strong international presence, AI/R Company connects talent and technology to accelerate digital transformation for its clients, fostering a collaborative, multicultural environment focused on continuous innovation.

This person will be responsible for driving strategic hiring processes, supporting regional leadership in team expansion, and ensuring excellence in both candidate and internal stakeholder experience.


We are seeking a hands-on professional with strong experience in international technical recruiting within IT consulting, strategic mindset, leadership capabilities, and a results-driven approach.

This role will have constant interaction with global stakeholders, technology leaders, and business areas, making strong communication skills, prioritization, and the ability to thrive in dynamic, multicultural environments essential.


Key responsibilities

  • Lead the LATAM Talent Acquisition team, fostering development, performance tracking, and best recruiting practices
  • Drive attraction and selection strategies for technical roles across various seniority levels and technologies
  • Actively manage international recruitment processes across Latin America and/or North America
  • Align hiring strategies with technology leaders, operations, and executive leadership
  • Ensure agility, quality, and predictability in recruitment processes
  • Conduct market mapping and develop sourcing strategies for highly specialized profiles
  • Monitor recruitment metrics and continuously improve funnel performance, SLA, conversion rates, and candidate experience
  • Structure and optimize recruitment processes, policies, and tools
  • Participate in global meetings and collaborate with international teams


Required qualifications

  • Strong experience in Talent Acquisition with a focus on technical recruiting
  • Previous experience in IT consulting or outsourcing companies
  • Proven experience leading recruitment teams
  • Strong background in international hiring, especially across LATAM
  • Experience recruiting roles such as Software Engineers, QA, DevOps, Data, Cloud, SAP, among others
  • Advanced or fluent English for interviews and meetings
  • Experience with active sourcing and talent attraction strategies
  • Analytical, organized, and metrics-driven profile


Nice to have

  • Intermediate or advanced Spanish
  • Experience with LATAM operations expansion
  • Experience in multicultural and high-volume environments
  • Knowledge of ATS systems, recruitment metrics, and TA automation
  • Experience working with global clients in the U.S. or Canada
